title: Topological Band Theory for High-Dimensional Parameter Spaces
summary: We study the topological band theory of quantum Hall systems in which the adiabatic flux parameters of an external gauge potential form a high-dimensional manifold. This situation arises both for strongly correlated matter on spatial Riemann surfaces of genus $g > 1$, as well as in the formal study of matter on compact oriented manifolds of dimension $4\ell+2 = 2p$ coupled to $p$-form gauge potentials. In these cases, the underlying topological invariants defined over the parameter space are significantly richer than the low-dimensional (i.e., two-dimensional) case and involve both the curvature (i.e., first Chern class) as well as higher order curvature invariants. These higher curvature invariants correspond to topologically protected contributions to Kubo-like formulae, constructed from correlation functions of the physical current operators. We illustrate these general considerations with an explicit example from hyperbolic band theory based on the genus-two Bolza Riemann surface, a case which has recently been simulated on a synthetic-dimension platform.

AI.tldr: 本文将量子霍尔系统的拓扑能带理论推广到绝热磁通参数构成高维流形的情形，揭示其拓扑不变量比二维情形更丰富，包含曲率（第一陈类）及高阶曲率项，对应Kubo公式中的拓扑保护贡献，并以亏格2 Bolza黎曼面上的双曲能带理论为例。
AI.motivation: 传统量子霍尔系统拓扑不变量定义在二维参数空间，但在空间为高亏格黎曼面或偶数维紧致流形耦合高阶形式规范势时，参数空间维度升高，需要更丰富的拓扑不变量理论。
AI.method: 研究绝热磁通参数形成高维流形时的拓扑能带理论，分析定义在参数空间上的拓扑不变量（含第一陈类和高阶曲率不变量），并将其与物理电流算符关联函数构成的Kubo型公式对应。
AI.result: 发现高维情形下拓扑不变量显著丰富，涉及曲率与高阶曲率项，这些高阶曲率不变量对应Kubo型公式中的拓扑保护贡献；以亏格2 Bolza黎曼面的双曲能带理论为显式例子，该体系已在合成维度平台模拟。
AI.conclusion: 高维参数空间量子霍尔系统具有比二维情形更丰富的拓扑结构，高阶曲率不变量提供拓扑保护的Kubo贡献，为高亏格表面与高维流形上的关联物质研究提供框架。

title: Magnetoplasmon molecule
summary: We investigate a two-dimensional electron system in an external magnetic field. An intrinsic four-particle excitation of the electron system, which we term a magnetoplasmon molecule, is observed. The molecule comprises two identical electrons and two Fermi holes with opposite spins. Both electrons and one Fermi hole participate in the collective plasma oscillations of the electron system, whereas the second Fermi hole neutralizes the excess electronic charge. We examine the interaction between the magnetoplasmon molecule and a magnetoexciton condensate.

AI.tldr: 研究二维电子在外磁场下的本征四粒子激发，提出"磁等离子体分子"概念，并探讨其与磁激子凝聚体的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 探究二维电子系统在外磁场中新型本征激发的本质及其与凝聚态的相互作用。
AI.method: 理论分析二维电子系统在外磁场中的集体激发；识别由两个相同电子和两个相反自旋费米空穴构成的四粒子激发（磁等离子体分子），并分析其与磁激子凝聚体的相互作用。
AI.result: 观察到一种本征四粒子激发——磁等离子体分子；其中两个电子和一个费米空穴参与等离子集体振荡，第二个费米空穴中和多余电子电荷。进一步考察了该分子与磁激子凝聚体的相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 磁等离子体分子是二维磁化电子系统中的一种新型本征激发，其与磁激子凝聚体的相互作用揭示了多体物理中的新耦合机制。

title: Topology Obstructs Nodeless Excitons
summary: Lowest-energy excitons are usually expected to have nodeless $1s$-like envelope wavefunctions. We show that band topology can obstruct this expectation. The exciton envelope wavefunction is a section of the valence-conduction transition bundle, whose topology can enforce momentum-space zeros, with their parity or signed total index fixed by the corresponding characteristic class. We exemplify this behavior in a minimal $PT$-symmetric three-band model with a rank-two transition bundle characterized by Euler number $ν^e=2$. By directly solving the Bethe-Salpeter equation with both contact and Rytova-Keldysh interactions, we find that the lowest exciton contains two zeros, each with index $+1$, and is less strongly bound than its topologically trivial counterpart. We further classify topology-enforced exciton nodal structures for real and complex transition bundles in dimensions $d \leq 3$. Our results establish the topology of the transition bundle as a direct constraint on exciton wavefunctions and spectra.

AI.tldr: 最低能激子的包络波函数不一定无节点；能带拓扑可强制其在动量空间出现零点，其宇称或总指数由跃迁丛的特征类决定。
AI.motivation: 传统上认为最低能激子具有类似1s的无节点包络波函数，本文指出能带拓扑可以阻碍这一预期。
AI.method: 将激子包络波函数视为价带-导带跃迁丛的截面，用其特征类分析零点；在PT对称三能带最小模型中（跃迁丛为二维、Euler数ν^e=2），直接求解含contact与Rytova-Keldysh相互作用的Bethe-Salpeter方程；并对d≤3的实/复跃迁丛的拓扑强制节点结构进行分类。
AI.result: 最低激子包含两个各带+1指数的零点，且比拓扑平庸对应态结合更弱；给出了不同维度跃迁丛下拓扑强制激子节点结构的分类。
AI.conclusion: 跃迁丛的拓扑对激子波函数和谱构成直接约束，建立了激子物理与能带拓扑的联系。

title: Unveiling Three-Dimensional Skyrmion Transitions Through Vortices and Monopoles
summary: Magnetic skyrmions represent vortex-like spin configurations that provide a robust platform for next-generation spintronic technologies. Although they are often treated as two-dimensional objects with integer topological charge, their extension into three-dimensional strings realizes other composite structures with unique device functionalities that transcend planar frameworks. Unfortunately, a lack of bulk probes has failed to realize such higher-dimensional topological structures and their implementations. Here, we report the first experimental visualization of three-dimensional topological $Q = 0$ skyrmion structures using neutron scattering tomography techniques across the equilibrium phase of a Co$_8$Zn$_8$Mn$_4$ sample. Disordered skyrmion states reveal metastable skyrmioniums and composite topological objects novel to bulk systems. Vortex-antivortex lattices mediate changes in topology, with unprecedented transition pathways via a coupling of merons and monopoles. The present realization of bulk Q = 0 quasiparticles and meron-mediated dynamics paves the way for higher-dimensional spintronic frameworks through multi-bit encoding architectures, unidirectional transport schemes, and monopole-mediated controls.

AI.tldr: 本文首次利用中子散射断层扫描技术，在Co₈Zn₈Mn₄样品中实验可视化了三维拓扑Q=0天空粒子结构，揭示了亚稳skyrmionium及涡旋-反涡旋晶格中介的拓扑转变，为高维自旋电子学框架奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 传统磁天空粒子多被视为整数拓扑荷的二维物体，向三维弦状扩展可实现独特器件功能，但因缺乏体探测手段，高维拓扑结构一直未被实验实现和利用。
AI.method: 采用中子散射断层扫描技术，在Co₈Zn₈Mn₄样品的平衡相中观测三维拓扑Q=0天空粒子结构，分析无序天空粒子态的亚稳态与拓扑转变路径。
AI.result: 首次实验可视化三维Q=0天空粒子结构；发现亚稳skyrmionium与复合拓扑物体；涡旋-反涡旋晶格介导拓扑变化，并通过meron与monopole耦合实现前所未有的转变路径。
AI.conclusion: 体相Q=0准粒子与meron介导动力学的实现，为多比特编码架构、单向输运方案及monopole介导控制等高维自旋电子学框架开辟了道路。

title: Enhanced Critical Currents and Irreversibility Fields in YBa$_2$Cu$_4$O$_8$ Films through Ca-Substitution
summary: The intrinsic carrier concentration of superconducting materials may not be optimal, and different superconducting properties may have distinct optimal doping levels. Here, we show that Ca substitution increases the hole concentration in intrinsically underdoped epitaxial (Y$_{1-x}$Ca$_x$)Ba$_2$Cu$_4$O$_8$ (YCa124) films with $x \leq 0.10$, driving YCa124 toward optimal doping, increasing $T_c$ and $J_c$. At 40 K, 10% Ca doping increases $J_c$ by factors of 2.4 and 10 at 0.03 and 6 T, respectively, compared with the undoped film. The field dependence of $J_c$ follows $J_c \propto B^{-0.5}$, independent of Ca content, indicating that Ca substitution does not alter the dominant pinning mechanism. This field dependence is consistent with pinning by planar Y-125 stacking-fault intergrowths observed by electron microscopy. In addition, Ca substitution slows thermally activated vortex motion (creep) at $T \gtrsim 15$ K, while at lower temperatures the creep rate $S$ shows an unusual decrease with increasing field. Finally, we consider how doping tunes the upper bound on $J_c$, set by the depairing current density $J_d$, and the lower bound on creep, set by the Ginzburg parameter $G_i$. We find positive correlations between $J_c$ and $J_d$, and between $S$ and $G_i$, and compare them with trends across a broad range of superconductors.

AI.tldr: Ca替代提高欠掺杂YBa2Cu4O8薄膜的空穴浓度，使其趋近最优掺杂，提升Tc和Jc，但不改变主导钉扎机制，并影响涡旋蠕动和临界电流上界。
AI.motivation: 超导材料本征载流子浓度未必最优，且不同超导性质可能有不同的最优掺杂水平，因此需要研究掺杂如何调控临界温度、临界电流及涡旋钉扎行为。
AI.method: 在欠掺杂外延(Y1-xCax)Ba2Cu4O8薄膜中进行Ca替代（x≤0.10），测量Tc、Jc、磁场依赖关系、热激活涡旋蠕动率S，并结合电子显微镜观察钉扎结构，分析退配对电流密度Jd和Ginzburg参数Gi。
AI.result: 10% Ca掺杂在40 K下使Jc在0.03 T和6 T分别提高2.4倍和10倍；Jc随磁场满足Jc∝B^-0.5且与Ca含量无关；Ca替代减缓T≳15 K的热激活蠕动，低温下S随磁场异常降低；发现Jc与Jd正相关、S与Gi正相关。
AI.conclusion: Ca替代通过增加空穴浓度使YCa124趋近最优掺杂，从而提升Tc和Jc，但不改变主导钉扎机制；掺杂还调控Jc上界和涡旋蠕动下界，并与多种超导体的趋势一致。

title: A partially linearized mapping approach to surface hopping (MASH-PLDM) for nonadiabatic dynamics and nonlinear spectroscopy
summary: We derive a partially linearized version of the mapping approach to surface hopping (MASH) that provides a new method for simulating nonadiabatic dynamics in molecular systems. As in the original MASH formalism, trajectories travel on adiabatic surfaces with hops determined by the dynamics of a spin vector on the Bloch sphere. However, because the new approach is based on the partially linearized density matrix (PLDM), it has two spin vectors, which may be in the same or different hemispheres of the Bloch sphere. The former scenario describes an electronic population moving on a single adiabatic surface, whereas the latter describes a coherence moving on the average surface. We show that this new method, called MASH-PLDM, leads to improved results over the original MASH dynamics for a variety of scattering problems and spin-boson models, especially in cases where coherences play an important role. A further benefit of the new methodology is that it can treat multi-time correlation functions such as those required for nonlinear spectroscopy. We demonstrate this capability with a proof-of-principle simulation of time-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 提出MASH-PLDM方法，基于部分线性化密度矩阵改进MASH，用于非绝热动力学模拟。
AI.motivation: 原MASH方法在相干性主导的情形下表现不足，且无法处理多时间关联函数（如非线性光谱所需）。
AI.method: 结合部分线性化密度矩阵(PLDM)对映射方法MASH进行部分线性化，引入两个自旋向量，可在Bloch球同/异半球；前者描述单绝热面上的电子布居，后者描述平均面上的相干。
AI.result: 在多种散射问题和自旋-玻色模型上优于原MASH，尤其在相干性重要时；并能处理多时间关联函数，用时间分辨泵浦-探测光谱做原理验证。
AI.conclusion: MASH-PLDM提升了非绝热动力学精度，并拓展至非线性光谱等多时间关联函数模拟。

title: Memory-induced optimal switching in a dynamic Ising-Kuramoto model
summary: We study a globally coupled stochastic system in which each unit carries an Ising spin and a continuous phase. The spins undergo Glauber switching with relaxation rate $γ$, while the phases are driven by Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise with correlation time $τ$. A spin-dependent phase interaction supports a composite coherent mode, $Z_m=N^{-1}\sum_jσ_j e^{iθ_j}$, that can order even when the ordinary phase coherence is small. Linear response about the nonmagnetic incoherent state gives the synchronization threshold $K_{\mathrm c}=[(μ+β_sγ)χ_γ]^{-1}$, where $χ_γ$ is a memory-weighted Laplace transform of the free phase correlation function. The competition between the increasing Glauber response and the decreasing memory susceptibility produces a finite switching rate at which $K_{\mathrm c}$ is minimized. We derive a general sufficient condition for such an interior optimum and show that finite-time Ornstein-Uhlenbeck correlations satisfy the required fast-switching asymptotics, whereas the white-noise limit need not. Finite-size simulations reproduce the nonmonotonic threshold, its shift toward slower switching as $τ$ increases, antiphase composite order in a nonmagnetic state, and mode mixing on a magnetized background.

AI.tldr: 研究自旋-相位耦合随机系统中的复合相干模式，推导同步阈值并发现切换速率存在最优值。
AI.motivation: 普通相位相干性较弱时，仍可能存在由自旋与相位耦合支撑的复合有序模式，其同步条件与最优参数尚未明确。
AI.method: 对全局耦合系统在非磁非相干态附近做线性响应，得到同步阈值 K_c；分析Glauber切换响应与记忆敏感性的竞争，推导内部最优的充分条件，并进行有限尺寸模拟。
AI.result: 阈值 K_c=[(μ+β_sγ)χ_γ]^{-1}，随切换速率γ非单调变化并在有限γ处最小；τ增大使最优点向慢切换移动；有限时间OU噪声满足快速切换渐近，而白噪声极限未必；模拟验证了非磁态中的反相复合序及磁化背景上的模式混合。
AI.conclusion: 自旋切换与相位记忆的竞争可产生复合相干模式的内最优同步阈值，有限相关时间对同步有利且能改变最优切换条件。

title: Linking Topological Medium Range Order and Density-Wave Coherence to Metallic Glass Ductility
summary: Metallic glasses exhibit pronounced composition-dependent mechanical properties, yet identifying the structural origins of these changes remains difficult. An outstanding issue is how to correlate different forms of medium range order (MRO), defined at different length scales and accessed through different experimental observables, and to understand their connection to properties. We combine synchrotron reduced density function, G(r), with machine-learning-assisted four dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) to examine geometric and topological MRO in five Zr-based metallic glasses. Density wave analysis of G(r) provides a geometric MRO descriptor through the coherence length of atomic density correlations, while 4D-STEM reveals nanoscale topological and chemical MRO motifs, including crystal-like local ordering with distinct rotational symmetries. We show that the G(r)-derived coherence length captures an important baseline tendency for cooperative ductile relaxation, while composition-dependent topological MRO provides an additional structural contribution that helps explain the observed mechanical responses. In particular, increasing Zr content suppresses Cu-rich FCC-like MRO, increases the cooperative coherence volume, and promotes fine Zr-rich HCP-like local order associated with enhanced ductility. These results identify the combined structural influence of geometric and topological MRO as a key basis for composition-dependent mechanical response in metallic glasses.

AI.tldr: 结合同步辐射约化密度函数G(r)与机器学习辅助4D-STEM，在五种Zr基金属玻璃中关联几何与拓扑中程有序（MRO），揭示其共同决定成分依赖的力学响应。
AI.motivation: 金属玻璃力学性能强烈依赖成分，但其结构起源不清。关键难题在于：不同长度尺度、不同实验手段所定义的各类中程有序（MRO）之间难以关联，也难以与性能建立联系。
AI.method: 对五种Zr基金属玻璃，同时使用同步辐射约化密度函数G(r)与机器学习辅助的四维扫描透射电镜（4D-STEM）。对G(r)做密度波分析，以原子密度关联的相干长度作为几何MRO描述符；4D-STEM用于解析纳米尺度拓扑与化学MRO基元，包括具不同旋转对称性的类晶体局域有序。
AI.result: G(r)相干长度捕捉了协同韧性弛豫的重要基线趋势；成分依赖的拓扑MRO提供额外结构贡献，可解释力学响应。提高Zr含量会抑制富Cu的FCC类MRO，增大协同相干体积，并促进与韧性提升相关的细小富Zr HCP类局域有序。
AI.conclusion: 几何与拓扑MRO的联合结构影响是金属玻璃成分依赖力学响应的关键基础。

title: Advancing Fuzzy-Sphere CFTs: $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-Rotation-Resolving Exact Diagonalization, 3D Ising Heavy Primaries, and Quasi-Hole-Space Projection
summary: Fuzzy-sphere regularization has recently emerged as a powerful framework for studying three-dimensional conformal field theories (CFTs). In this work, we exploit symmetry and Hilbert-space structures to substantially advance this framework. We develop an exact-diagonalization algorithm that resolves the full $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ rotational symmetry, reducing computational costs by factors of several hundred. For the three-dimensional Ising CFT, we identify around 100 primary operators, including a large number of previously unknown heavy scalar primaries up to scaling dimension $Δ\approx16.5$. We also resolve the tension between previous fuzzy-sphere and bootstrap results regarding the parity-odd scalar primary. Furthermore, we identify a branch of scalar primaries associated with $φ^n$ operators in the $φ^4$ Lagrangian description, beginning with the identity, $σ$, $ε$, $ε'$, and $σ'$. Their wave functions exhibit a semi-classical structure closely related to states invariant under area-preserving diffeomorphisms of the sphere. Finally, we show that critical points involving fractional quantum Hall states can be studied within a substantially reduced Hilbert space spanned by quasi-hole states of the corresponding model quantum Hall wave functions like the Laughlin state. This suggests a general strategy for exploring CFTs intertwined with topologically ordered phases.

AI.tldr: 本文利用对称性与希尔伯特空间结构改进模糊球正则化框架，开发出保持SO(3)旋转对称的精确对角化算法，大幅提升计算效率并深入刻画三维Ising CFT。
AI.motivation: 模糊球正则化是研究三维共形场论的有力框架，但计算成本高，且此前在宇称奇标量原初算子等问题上存在模糊球与bootstrap结果的分歧，亟需更高效且精确的方法。
AI.method: 开发保留完整SO(3)旋转对称性的精确对角化算法；利用对称性和希尔伯特空间结构降低计算量；并针对含分数量子霍尔态的临界点，构建由准空穴态（如Laughlin态）张成的约化希尔伯特空间进行研究。
AI.result: 计算成本降低数百倍；在三维Ising CFT中识别出约100个原初算子，包括大量此前未知、标度维度高达Δ≈16.5的重标量原初算子；解决了关于宇称奇标量原初算子的模糊球与bootstrap之争；发现与φ^4描述中φ^n算子相关的标量原初分支（从恒等、σ、ε、ε'、σ'开始），其波函数呈与保面积微分同胚不变态相关的半经典结构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作显著推进了模糊球正则化框架，为三维CFT谱学提供了高效工具，并提出了探索与拓扑有序相纠缠的CFT的一般策略。

title: Permeability and microcrack geometry: Dynamic loading induced evolution
comment: 55 pages, 13 figures, includes a Supplementary Material
summary:
We propose a crack-geometry-based model for permeability evolution in rocks under dynamic loading. Accurate representation of permeability is important for fluid extraction and containment in geological formations, but remains challenging because low-porosity brittle rocks are highly sensitive to changes in pore geometry and connectivity, while dynamic permeability measurements are limited.
  Rock void space is represented as an evolving network of penny-shaped cracks with prescribed orientations. Permeability changes are described through crack microvariables including aperture, length, and crack distance. The model accounts for crack opening and closure, fracture-energy-driven propagation, plastic-strain-driven nucleation, coalescence after full connectivity is reached, and strain-rate-dependent fracture toughening. The evolving crack network directly modifies connectivity, fluid conductance, and preferential flow paths.
  The formulation is implemented in the GeoDyn hydrocode and evaluated under tension, shear, compression, and symmetric impact loading. Results show a strong relation between permeability and crack length, with crack propagation playing a major role in permeability enhancement. Permeability growth can nevertheless be limited by poor connectivity and crack closure. The model captures changes of several orders of magnitude depending on stress state, strain rate, crack orientation, and connectivity, consistent with observed behavior of brittle rocks under high strain-rate loading.

AI.tldr: 提出基于裂纹几何的模型，用微裂纹网络描述动载下岩石渗透率演化，并在GeoDyn程序中验证。
AI.motivation: 低孔隙度脆性岩石渗透率对孔隙几何与连通性高度敏感，而动载渗透率实测数据有限，现有表征困难。
AI.method: 将岩石孔隙表征为定向penny-shaped裂纹演化网络，以裂纹开度、长度、间距为微观变量，纳入开裂闭合、断裂能驱动扩展、塑性应变成核、连通后合并及应变率相关的断裂增韧，耦合连通性、流体导度与优势流路径，在GeoDyn流体动力学程序中实现。
AI.result: 在拉伸、剪切、压缩及对称冲击载荷下评估，渗透率与裂纹长度强相关，裂纹扩展主导渗透率提升；但受连通性差和裂纹闭合限制，渗透率可随应力状态、应变率、裂纹方向和连通性变化数个数量级，与脆性岩石高应变率行为一致。
AI.conclusion: 该裂纹几何模型能合理刻画动载下岩石渗透率的量级变化，为动态渗透率演化提供了可行表征方法。

title: Effects of Longitudinal Spin Current Density Gradient on Spin-Orbit Torque Switching of Perpendicular Magnetization
summary: It has remained a critical open question as to whether a longitudinal spin current gradient (e.g., due to a gradient in the thickness, composition, or width) can replace the longitudinal magnetic field required for deterministic spin-orbit torque switching of normal metal/ferromagnet heterostructures with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Here, we report robust micromagnetic and experimental evidence that any realistic longitudinal spin-current density gradient cannot be an effective replacement for a longitudinal magnetic field to enable deterministic switching of a perpendicular magnetic anisotropy device. Instead, the longitudinal spin current density can only modify the nucleation and pulse-timing-sensitive oscillations of magnetic domains and thus the picosecond-scale strip-like indeterministic switching windows. The same conclusions hold robustly when the transverse effective field associated with the spin-current pulse (the sum of the Oersted field and field-like torque) is taken into account. The indeterministic switching prevents applications in the presence of finite device-to-device variations and drifts in write current pulse and thermal fluctuations of device parameters. We also experimentally show that, instead of a longitudinal spin current density gradient, perpendicular spins are much more effective in deterministic switching of perpendicular spin torque devices.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"纵向自旋流梯度可替代纵向磁场实现确定性SOT翻转"的观点，通过微磁学与实验证明其不成立。
AI.motivation: 解决自旋轨道力矩（SOT）翻转垂直磁各向异性（PMA）异质结时是否必须依赖纵向磁场这一关键开放问题，探索用纵向自旋流密度梯度替代纵向磁场实现确定性翻转的可能性。
AI.method: 采用稳健的微磁学模拟并结合实验验证，考察纵向自旋流密度梯度（厚度、成分或宽度梯度引起）对PMA器件翻转的影响；同时纳入自旋流脉冲相关的横向有效场（奥斯特场与类场力矩之和）。
AI.result: 任何现实的纵向自旋流密度梯度都无法有效替代纵向磁场来实现确定性翻转；它只能改变磁畴的成核与脉冲时序敏感的振荡，从而形成皮秒量级的条状非确定性翻转窗口。考虑横向有效场后结论依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 纵向自旋流梯度导致的非确定性翻转会因器件间差异、写入电流脉冲漂移及热涨落而无法应用；实验表明垂直自旋比纵向自旋流密度梯度更有效地实现垂直自旋力矩器件的确定性翻转。

title: Evanescent-wave Johnson Noise from Superconductors
summary: We compute the evanescent-wave Johnson noise (EWJN) in the vacuum half-space above a superconductor, and the resulting relaxation time ($T_1$) of spin and charge qubits placed at nanometer distances from the surface. The electromagnetic response is described by a single microscopic transverse current-response kernel $Q(q, ω)$ for a BCS superconductor. This is computed for varying densities of both non-magnetic impurities and magnetic impurities, for arbitrary frequency and temperature and for wave vectors $q \ll k_F$ (the Fermi wavevector). When combined with the fluctuation-dissipation theorem and the nonlocal surface impedances of the half-space, this yields the magnetic and electric field noise at any distance $z \gg k_F^{-1}$ from the surface, from which we obtain $T_1$. Just below $T_c$ the magnetic noise is enhanced relative to the normal state by the coherence (Hebel-Slichter-type) peak of the dissipative conductivity and drops exponentially at lower temperatures; the electric noise shows no coherence peak. The theory predicts that there is a zero-temperature noise floor induced by magnetic impurities. In the gapless regime produced by pair breaking, the finite subgap density of states $ν(0)$ yields a temperature-independent noise spectral density and a relaxation rate bounded by $T_1^{-1}(T)\le[ν(0)/ν_F]^{2}\,T_{1,N}^{-1}(T)$ for $T\ll T_c$, with equality in the extreme nonlocal regime. Here $ν(0)$ and $ν_F$ are the superconducting and normal-state densities of states at the Fermi energy, and $T_{1,N}(T)$ is the relaxation time the same electrode would produce in its normal state at the same temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文计算了超导体上方真空中消逝波约翰逊噪声（EWJN），以及放置在距表面纳米级处的自旋和电荷量子比特的弛豫时间 T1。
AI.motivation: 理解超导体表面附近的量子比特弛豫机制，特别是杂质、温度和相干效应如何影响噪声与 T1。
AI.method: 采用 BCS 超导体的微观横向电流响应核 Q(q, ω)，考虑磁性与非磁性杂质、任意频率和温度、q ≪ kF；结合涨落-耗散定理与非局域表面阻抗得到电磁场噪声与 T1。
AI.result: Tc 以下磁噪声因耗散电导的相干峰（Hebel-Slichter 型）增强，低温指数下降；电噪声无相干峰。磁性杂质导致零温噪声底；破对产生的无能隙区给出温度无关噪声谱密度，且 T1^-1 ≤ [ν(0)/νF]^2 T1,N^-1，在极端非局域极限取等号。
AI.conclusion: 该理论刻画了超导电极中杂质与破对效应对量子比特噪声和弛豫的限制，预言了磁噪声零温底及无能隙区的弛豫率上限。

title: Minor Structural Differences Tune Functional Specialization of Antenna Subunits in the PSII Energy Transfer Network
summary: Photosystem II (PSII) contains a diverse array of pigment-protein subunits with specialized roles in the antenna network. We investigate the functional significance of this subunit diversity in two structurally similar yet functionally distinct PSII subunits: minor light-harvesting complex CP29 and major light-harvesting complex LHCII. We combine two-dimensional electronic-vibrational spectroscopy with lifetime density analysis and structure-based kinetic modeling to assign spectral features to exciton states, providing molecular detail to probed spectral features. We show how the distinct pigment compositions of CP29 and Lhcb1, a monomeric subunit of the major LHCII trimer, reshape excitonic connectivity and energy transfer pathways in the complexes. Compared to Lhcb1, energy transfer pathways in CP29 are more spatially connected and reversible, suggesting CP29 evolved to distribute excitation between the core and periphery of the PSII antenna. We find that small structural modifications from a common framework tune CP29 and Lhcb1 to complementary roles in the PSII supercomplex.

AI.tldr: 本文结合2D电子-振动光谱、寿命密度分析与基于结构的动力学建模，揭示了PSII中CP29与Lhcb1因色素组成差异而导致激子连接和能量转移路径的不同，二者协同互补。
AI.motivation: PSII含有多种色素-蛋白亚基，其在天线网络中的功能意义尚不明确，尤其结构相似但功能不同的CP29与LHCII的差异机制有待阐明。
AI.method: 结合二维电子-振动光谱、寿命密度分析和基于结构的动力学建模，将光谱特征归属到激子态，并比较CP29与Lhcb1的色素组成、激子连接及能量转移路径。
AI.result: 相比Lhcb1，CP29的能量转移路径在空间上更连通、更具可逆性，表明CP29演化出在PSII天线核心与外围之间分配激发的功能。
AI.conclusion: 来自共同框架的微小结构修饰使CP29与Lhcb1在天线系统中承担互补角色。

title: Nonreciprocal Chiral Automata
summary: Odd pressure is a parity-odd transport coefficient that gives an isotropic pressure response to vorticity in compressible two-dimensional fluids. By asymmetrically coupling vortical and compressional modes, it provides a direct mechanism for a nonreciprocal hydrodynamic response reminiscent of several biological systems. Yet microscopic models realizing odd pressure as a transport coefficient are relatively scarce. Here, we construct one such model using a lattice-gas cellular automaton based on the Frisch-Hasslacher-Pomeau II model with rest particles and chiral collisions, whose Chapman-Enskog coarse-graining produces a nonzero odd pressure coefficient. The key ingredient is a local parity-breaking collision that weakly rotates moving particles in the presence of a rest particle. At hydrodynamic scales, this microscopic rule acts as an effective magnetic field, converting the model's bulk viscosity into odd pressure. More generally, we derive expressions relating Hall viscosity, odd pressure, and odd torque to their parity-even counterparts in our model.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于FHP-II晶格气元胞自动机的手性碰撞模型，通过Chapman-Enskog粗粒化产生非零奇压（odd pressure）输运系数。
AI.motivation: 奇压是二维可压缩流体中涡度引起各向同性压力响应的宇称奇输运系数，可实现类似生物系统的非互易流体响应，但实现该系数的微观模型极其稀缺。
AI.method: 在含静止粒子的FHP-II模型基础上引入手性碰撞，即存在静止粒子时局部宇称破缺碰撞使运动粒子微弱旋转；经Chapman-Enskog粗粒化推导宏观输运系数。
AI.result: 该微观规则在流体尺度上等效于有效磁场，将体黏度转化为奇压，得到非零奇压系数，并导出Hall黏度、奇压、奇力矩与对应宇称偶量之间的关系式。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为以输运系数形式实现奇压提供了具体微观机制，并推广了宇称奇与宇称偶输运系数的联系。

title: Measuring trainable degrees of freedom in materials graph neural networks: a random-subspace intrinsic dimension analysis
summary: Final predictive accuracy is the standard basis for comparing graph neural networks (GNNs) in materials-property prediction, but it does not show how strongly performance depends on access to trainable parameter-space directions. Here, we introduce trainable-degree dependence as a complementary characterization of materials GNN learning. Using random-subspace intrinsic-dimension analysis, we train CGCNN, ALIGNN, and DimeNet++ in randomly oriented parameter subspaces across six prediction tasks and measure how performance recovers as independent trainable degrees of freedom are restored. The resulting recovery curves separate endpoint accuracy from the trainable-dimensional demand required to recover it. They reveal distinctions that final errors alone miss: metallic classification and log-bulk-modulus regression recover near-reference performance from small fractional subspaces, formation-energy and band-gap prediction show stronger architecture dependence, and phonon prediction is most sensitive to dimensional restriction. Dataset-size sweeps show that band-gap models require larger fractional subspaces as training data grows, whereas formation-energy and bulk-modulus responses are more stable. A width sweep shows that fractional thresholds can remain stable while absolute threshold dimensions increase with model size. Random-subspace analysis therefore provides a targeted stress test for how materials GNNs use their optimization space.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"可训练自由度依赖"作为材料GNN性能的补充刻画，通过随机子空间内在维度分析，研究CGCNN、ALIGNN、DimeNet++在六个任务中性能随可训练自由度恢复的变化。
AI.motivation: 最终预测精度是材料性质预测中比较GNN的标准依据，但无法反映性能对可训练参数空间方向的依赖程度，需要一种补充性刻画方法。
AI.method: 采用随机子空间内在维度分析，在随机取向的参数子空间中训练CGCNN、ALIGNN、DimeNet++，跨六个预测任务测量性能随独立可训练自由度恢复的变化，并进行数据集规模和模型宽度扫描。
AI.result: 恢复曲线将端点精度与所需可训练维度需求分离：金属分类和对数体积模量回归在小子空间即可恢复近参考性能；形成能和带隙预测表现更强的架构依赖；声子预测对维度限制最敏感。带隙模型随数据增大需要更大子空间比例，形成能和体积模量更稳定；宽度扫描显示分数阈值稳定时绝对阈值维度随模型增大而增加。
AI.conclusion: 随机子空间分析为材料GNN如何利用优化空间提供了一种有针对性的压力测试。

title: Spectroscopy of phonon-coupled integer and fractional Chern insulators: emergence of polarons and chirality deficit of graviton mode
summary: Strong electron-phonon coupling can destabilize both Chern insulators (CIs) and fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) in favor of charge order, but whether the instabilities in CI and FCI share a common microscopic mechanism remains unclear. In this paper, we address this question by studying a flat-band Haldane model coupled to dynamical Holstein phonons at integer and fractional fillings using density-matrix renormalization group with local basis optimization. We find that the low-energy effects of phonons are dominated by their dressing of charge-neutral collective modes. In the CI and FCI, phonons dress excitons and magnetorotons into composite modes that we identify as exciton polarons and magnetoroton polarons, respectively. These modes soften strongly upon approaching the transition, while the momenta of their energy minima anticipate the ordering wave vectors of the charge-ordered phases. The phonon spectrum, in turn, acquires dispersive features inherited from the exciton and magnetoroton modes, providing direct lattice signatures of these neutral excitations. Within the FCI phase, electron-phonon coupling also enhances the opposite-chirality spectral weight of the graviton response, thereby resulting in a chirality deficit. Our results provide a unified excitation-based picture of phonon-driven instabilities in CIs and FCIs and establish lattice dynamics as a probe of their neutral collective modes.

AI.tldr: 本文用DMRG+局域基优化研究平带Haldane模型耦合Holstein声子，在整数与分数填充下揭示了CI与FCI中声子驱动失稳的统一激发图像：声子主要修饰中性集体模式，形成激子极化子和磁旋子极化子。
AI.motivation: 强电子-声子耦合可破坏Chern绝缘体(CI)和分数Chern绝缘体(FCI)而倾向电荷序，但二者失稳是否共享同一微观机制尚不清楚，本文旨在回答这一问题。
AI.method: 在平带Haldane模型中引入动态Holstein声子，采用带局域基优化的密度矩阵重整化群(DMRG)，分别在整数填充(CI)和分数填充(FCI)下进行数值研究。
AI.result: 发现声子的低能效应主要由其对电荷中性集体模式的修饰主导：在CI和FCI中，声子分别将激子和磁旋子修饰为"激子极化子"和"磁旋子极化子"复合模式。这些模式在接近相变时强烈软化，其能量极小值对应的动量预示了电荷序相的序波矢。声子谱反过来继承激子和磁旋子色散特征，为这些中性激发提供晶格探测信号。在FCI相内，电子-声子耦合还增强引力子响应的相反手性谱权重，导致手性缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了声子驱动CI与FCI失稳的统一激发图像，并确立晶格动力学作为探测其中性集体模式的手段。

title: Moment hierarchy and exact steady-state solutions in a Callaway lattice Boltzmann model for phonon hydrodynamics
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures; Supplemental Material included as an ancillary file
summary: We analyze the moment hierarchy of a Callaway lattice Boltzmann model for phonon hydrodynamics and derive exact steady-state solutions for a driven planar channel with diffuse walls. The collision operator decomposes the population space into conserved, heat-flux, and fast kinetic sectors, whose coupling through streaming determines the transport response. For the two-dimensional, eight-velocity (D2Q8) lattice Boltzmann model, we derive a fully discrete closure that relates the heat flux to transverse kinetic moments. The higher-order transverse kinetic moment contains both a second-difference term and an explicit contribution from the imposed energy drop. Diffuse-wall population constraints then determine the heat-flux and kinetic-moment profiles without fitted parameters. The resulting solution reproduces the numerical bulk moment amplitudes and wall slip, while an exact wall relation separates the contribution of the higher-order moment from deviations from the leading gradient approximation. Finite-wave-number analysis further resolves the collision-sector mixing associated with longitudinal propagation. These results provide a unified description of collision relaxation, the moment hierarchy, and boundary response within the specified discrete model.

AI.tldr: 本文对Callaway晶格玻尔兹曼声子流体力学模型的矩层级进行解析，推导了具有漫射壁的驱动平面通道的精确稳态解，实现了对碰撞弛豫、矩层级与边界响应的统一描述。
AI.motivation: 解析声子流体力学中Callaway晶格玻尔兹曼模型的矩层级耦合与边界响应机制，期望无需拟合参数即可精确刻画通道内的热流与壁面滑移。
AI.method: 针对二维八速度（D2Q8）模型，将群体空间分解为守恒、热流与快动理学扇区；推导将热流与横向动理学矩关联的全离散闭合关系（含二阶差分项和能量降贡献）；利用漫射壁群体约束确定热流与动理学矩剖面；并进行有限波数分析。
AI.result: 所得解复现了数值体动理学矩幅值与壁面滑移；给出一个精确壁面关系，将高阶矩贡献与领先梯度近似的偏差分离；有限波数分析揭示了纵向传播相关的碰撞扇区混合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为指定离散模型内碰撞弛豫、矩层级与边界响应提供了统一的解析描述。

title: Magnetic-field-activated transport from band geometry in gapped nodal-line semimetals
summary: We develop a nonperturbative semiclassical theory of magnetotransport in gapped nodal-line semimetals, retaining the full magnetic-field dependence of Berry-curvature and orbital-magnetic-moment corrections. Starting from a minimal two-band model, we derive exact expressions for both the intrinsic Hall response and the dissipative Fermi-surface conductivity, valid to all orders in the magnetic field within the semiclassical regime. We show that the orbital magnetic moment reconstructs the geometrically active Fermi surface, breaking the azimuthal cancellation imposed by the nodal-line geometry and thereby activating an intrinsic Hall current that is absent at zero magnetic field. The Hall response exhibits a pronounced nonmonotonic dependence on the chemical potential and a strongly nonlinear magnetic-field evolution, reflecting the redistribution of geometrically active states around the nodal ring. We further demonstrate that the Fermi-surface conductivities recover the conventional Drude behavior in the weak-field limit, while acquiring quadratic and ultimately nonperturbative magnetic-field corrections together with a field-induced transport anisotropy that gives rise to a measurable planar Hall effect at intermediate fields. Both the intrinsic and dissipative responses are strongly enhanced when the Fermi level lies close to the nodal ring, where Berry curvature and orbital magnetic moment are largest. Our results identify magnetic-field-activated geometric transport as a characteristic signature of nodal-line semimetals and provide a unified framework for describing magnetotransport beyond perturbative magnetic-field expansions, together with experimentally accessible signatures of orbital-magnetic-moment physics.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了加隙节线半金属磁输运的非微扰半经典理论，保留贝里曲率和轨道磁矩修正的完整磁场依赖。
AI.motivation: 节线半金属的几何量子态（贝里曲率、轨道磁矩）在磁场下如何影响输运，尤其超越微扰展开的完整磁场响应，尚缺乏统一描述。
AI.method: 从最小两带模型出发，推导内禀霍尔响应与耗散费米面电导的精确表达式，在半经典区间内对磁场任意阶有效。
AI.result: 轨道磁矩重构几何活跃费米面，打破节线几何的方位角抵消，激活零场下不存在的内禀霍尔电流；霍尔响应随化学势非单调、随磁场强非线性；费米面电导在弱场回归Drude行为，中场出现二阶及非微扰修正和场致各向异性，产生可测平面霍尔效应；费米能级靠近节线时响应显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 确立磁场激活的几何输运为节线半金属的特征信号，提供超越微扰磁场展开的磁输运统一框架及轨道磁矩物理的可测特征。

title: Reversible field-free superconducting diode effect controlled by an antiferromagnet
summary: The semiconductor diode, which allows current to flow preferentially in one direction, is a fundamental building block of numerous modern electronic circuits. Its superconducting analogue---the superconducting diode effect---enables directional dissipationless current flow and may provide similar functionality in future superconducting quantum circuits. Realization of such a nonreciprocal supercurrent requires broken time-reversal symmetry. At zero applied field, this has been typically associated either with intrinsic unconventional superconductivity or extrinsic spin-split electronic states induced by magnetic proximity. Here we demonstrate a field-free superconducting diode effect in conventional superconducting Al proximitized by collinear antiferromagnetic CuMnAs, whose electronic structure breaks time-reversal symmetry without generating spin splitting. By tuning the proximity effect through an insulating AlAs interlayer and correlating the reversal of the diode polarity with the reversal of the remanent Néel state, we establish that the antiferromagnet controls the superconducting diode effect. Our results show that neither spin-split bands nor net magnetization is required for a magnetically controlled field-free superconducting diode effect, extending superconducting nonreciprocity to a broader class of collinear compensated magnets.

AI.tldr: 在传统超导Al与共线反铁磁CuMnAs的近邻效应体系中，实现了零外场超导二极管效应，并证明反铁磁的Néel态可控制二极管极性。
AI.motivation: 超导二极管效应需要破坏时间反演对称性，此前零场实现多依赖非常规超导或磁性近邻诱导的自旋劈裂电子态。本文探索无需自旋劈裂或净磁化即可实现零场超导二极管的可能性。
AI.method: 将传统超导Al与共线反铁磁CuMnAs构成近邻结构，通过插入绝缘AlAs层调控近邻效应，并关联剩余Néel态反转与二极管极性反转。
AI.result: 观察到零场超导二极管效应；二极管极性与CuMnAs剩余Néel态的反转相对应，说明反铁磁体控制该效应。
AI.conclusion: 磁性控制的零场超导二极管效应不要求自旋劈裂能带或净磁化，将超导非互易性扩展到更广泛的共线补偿磁体。

title: Anomalous pressure-dependent viscosity of basaltic melts and its role in asthenosphere melt accumulation
summary: The asthenosphere's mechanical weakness enables plate tectonics, but its origin is debated. Partial melt has been proposed to cause this softening, yet recent studies suggest that the measured viscosity minimum in basaltic melts, an essential control on melt mobility, is an experimental artifact. Using quantum mechanics-based, machine learning-accelerated molecular dynamics, we extend simulation timescales by more than a factor of 1000 and achieve percent-level precision. We show that basaltic melt exhibits a robust viscosity minimum (approximately 20% below 1-bar values) at approximately 3 GPa, driven by pressure-induced reorganization of aluminum coordination that facilitates shear relaxation while silicon-oxygen polyhedra remain structurally rigid. Our results reveal a depth-dependent rheological transition: melt mobility peaks below approximately 150 km, promoting efficient extraction, but declines sharply during ascent, causing melt to stagnate beneath the lithosphere. This mechanism provides a physical basis for the dual seismic signatures of a melt-depleted deep asthenosphere and a melt-enriched layer near the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary.

AI.tldr: 玄武质熔体的黏度极小值并非实验假象：通过量子力学结合机器学习加速的分子动力学模拟，作者证实约3 GPa处存在稳健的黏度极小值，源于压力诱导的铝配位重组，并据此提出软流圈熔体迁移的深度依赖机制。
AI.motivation: 软流圈的力学弱化是板块构造的前提，其成因存在争议。部分熔融被认为是软化原因，但近期研究指出玄武质熔体中测得的黏度极小值（熔体迁移性的关键控制因素）可能是实验假象，因此需要更可靠的模拟来澄清。
AI.method: 采用基于量子力学、由机器学习加速的分子动力学模拟，将模拟时间尺度延长超过1000倍，并达到百分比级精度。
AI.result: 玄武质熔体在约3 GPa处存在稳健的黏度极小值（比1 bar值低约20%），由压力诱导的铝配位重组驱动——该重组促进剪切松弛，而硅氧多面体保持结构刚性。熔体迁移性在约150 km以下达到峰值，随后在上升过程中急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: 该机制为软流圈的双重地震信号提供了物理基础：深部熔体亏损的软流圈与岩石圈-软流圈边界附近的熔体富集层。

title: Autonomous self-harmonic drift in Langevin dynamics causes a compaction of underlying domain for the density of Stochastic Localization
summary: Our recent research on Langevin dynamics with self-harmonic drift and classical spins has revealed a strong connection to ``Stochastic Localization," a concept attracting attention in the fields of mathematical geometry and data science. Roughly speaking, the former can be viewed as a version of the latter in which the $n$-dimensional Euclidean space - the domain of the probability distribution function appearing in the latter - is ``compactified'' to the surface of an $n$-dimensional sphere. By comparing the two frameworks, we argue that this compactification is a consequence of requiring the drift to be autonomous. The relationship between the two approaches may expand the scope of Stochastic Localization.

AI.tldr: 本文将带自谐漂移和经典自旋的Langevin动力学与随机局部化联系起来：前者可视为后者在n维球面上的"紧致化"版本。
AI.motivation: 近期关于自谐漂移与经典自旋的Langevin动力学研究与数学几何、数据科学中受关注的"随机局部化"（Stochastic Localization）存在强关联，作者希望厘清二者关系并拓展随机局部化的适用范围。
AI.method: 对比两个框架：随机局部化的定义域是n维欧氏空间，而Langevin动力学对应的是n维球面；通过比较论证该紧致化源于对漂移项自治性（autonomous）的要求。
AI.result: 指出球面紧致化是要求漂移自治的结果，并建立两种框架之间的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 两种方法的联系有望扩展随机局部化的研究范围。

title: Accelerating phase-field simulations on exascale computing systems for faster-than-real-time precipitate aging predictions
summary: Three-dimensional phase-field simulations are a gold-standard for microstructure prediction for materials, but their computational cost often limits application-relevant calculations to modest domain sizes and timescales. Here, we present a holistic approach for accelerating Fourier pseudospectral phase-field simulations by combining performance-portable GPU computing, large-scale distributed-memory parallelism, and high-order implicit-explicit time integration within the MEUMAPPS C++ framework. We demonstrate this approach with a 1.5-billion-grid-point simulation of the growth and coarsening of 1,920 gamma'' precipitates in a Ni-Nb-Fe alloy. The simulated seven-hour heat treatment is completed in 5.5 hours, making the calculation faster than real time and an estimated 217-501x faster than a CPU-only, first-order baseline. This performance makes three-dimensional simulations of thousands of interacting precipitates tractable, enabling quantitative studies ocollective microstructural phenomena, large simulation ensembles, and real-time integration into controlling and interpreting experiments. Benchmarking shows single-node GPU speedups of up to 17.5x relative to comparable CPU resources, near-ideal strong scaling to 4096 GPUs for a 12-billion-grid-point problem, and a further 2.6-2.9x acceleration from fourth-order time integration at scientifically relevant error tolerances. These results establish a performance-portable strategy for exploiting leadership-scale GPU systems that is applicable to a broad class of Fourier pseudospectral simulations beyond phase-field models such as fluid dynamics and crystal plasticity simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种综合加速Fourier伪谱相场模拟的方法，结合GPU计算、分布式并行与高阶隐式-显式时间积分，在Ni-Nb-Fe合金中实现比实时更快的十亿级网格模拟。
AI.motivation: 三维相场模拟虽是微观结构预测的金标准，但其计算成本高，通常只能处理较小的域尺寸和时间尺度，难以进行应用相关的计算。
AI.method: 在MEUMAPPS C++框架内，结合性能可移植的GPU计算、大规模分布式内存并行以及高阶隐式-显式（IMEX）时间积分，加速Fourier伪谱相场模拟。
AI.result: 完成15亿网格点、1920个gamma''析出相生长粗化的模拟：7小时热处理仅用5.5小时算完（快于实时），比CPU-only一阶基线快217-501倍；单节点GPU加速达17.5倍，4096 GPU近理想强扩展（120亿网格点），四阶时间积分再加速2.6-2.9倍。
AI.conclusion: 建立了可移植的性能策略以利用顶级规模GPU系统，适用于相场之外的一类Fourier伪谱模拟，如流体动力学和晶体塑性模拟。

title: Excitonic Stripe Order in the Two-Orbital Hubbard-Kanamori Model
summary: Excitonic condensation and stripe formation are two distinct manifestations of electronic correlations. While excitonic order naturally arises in multi-orbital systems, stripe order is a prominent feature of doped correlated-electron models. Here, we investigate an excitonic analogue of stripe order in the two--orbital Hubbard-Kanamori model on the square lattice, characterized by a spatial modulation of inter-orbital particle-hole coherence and, in the orbital-parity-symmetric limit, spontaneous breaking of a relative orbital $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry. Using unrestricted real-space Hartree-Fock calculations complemented by random-phase-approximation instability analysis, we determine how the Kanamori interactions select different excitonic channels. The sign of Hund's exchange controls the spin character of the condensate: ferromagnetic Hund coupling favors triplet excitonic order, whereas antiferromagnetic Hund coupling stabilizes singlet excitonic order. Upon doping, commensurate excitonic density waves develop incommensurate textures, including excitonic stripes and, in the triplet sector, spiral excitonic density waves. We further show that crystal-field splitting strongly reorganizes the excitonic instability by modifying inter-orbital nesting and can stabilize triplet excitonic order even in the absence of pair hopping. Our results establish excitonic stripes as a distinct symmetry-broken state of multi-orbital correlated systems and identify microscopic routes for their stabilization.

AI.tldr: 本文在双轨道Hubbard-Kanamori模型中研究激子条纹序，揭示其由空间调制的轨道间粒子-空穴相干性形成，并受Hund耦合符号、掺杂和晶体场劈裂调控。
AI.motivation: 激子凝聚与条纹形成是电子关联的两种不同表现，但二者的交叉——激子条纹序——尚缺乏系统研究。本文旨在探究多轨道关联体系中激子条纹序的形成机制与稳定条件。
AI.method: 采用无限制实空间Hartree-Fock计算，结合随机相近似(RPA)不稳定性分析，在方格子双轨道Hubbard-Kanamori模型中考察Kanamori相互作用如何选择不同激子通道。
AI.result: Hund交换符号决定凝聚体自旋性质：铁磁Hund耦合倾向三重态激子序，反铁磁Hund耦合稳定单态激子序。掺杂后公度激子密度波发展为非公度结构，包括激子条纹及三重态扇区的螺旋激子密度波。晶体场劈裂通过改变轨道间嵌套显著重组激子不稳定性，甚至可在无配对跳跃时稳定三重态激子序。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了激子条纹作为多轨道关联体系一种独特对称破缺态的地位，并指出了其稳定的微观途径。

title: TT-FDTD: Tensor Train Accelerated Three-Dimensional FDTD With Logarithmic Cost of Spatial Operators
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transaction on Microwave Theory and Techniques on July 27, 2026
summary: Quantized tensor-train (QTT) compression is incorporated into a full-vector three-dimensional scattered-field finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) formulation on uniform Yee grids. All six electromagnetic-field components, material-dependent update coefficients, equivalent-current sources, and staggered finite-difference operators are represented in compatible QTT form. Gaussian regularization of voxelized material interfaces is used to reduce the coefficient ranks generated by abrupt dielectric and conductivity transitions. The formulation is evaluated for an anatomically heterogeneous human-head model and a homogeneous dielectric sphere on grids containing up to $512^3$ spatial cells. The reported results show that interface smoothing substantially reduces material-coefficient ranks and that the TT--FDTD solution reproduces the full-grid transient fields with pointwise absolute errors on the order of $10^{-4}$ in the examined slices. Compared with conventional FDTD, the tensor representation greatly reduces storage at fine discretizations, although tensor contractions and recompression introduce additional per-step computational cost. These results demonstrate the feasibility and memory--time tradeoff of QTT-accelerated three-dimensional FDTD for large structured-grid simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将量化张量列(QTT)压缩融入全矢量三维FDTD散射场公式，在异构人头模型和均匀介质球上验证，实现显著存储节省但增加单步计算成本。
AI.motivation: 大规模结构化网格上三维FDTD仿真的内存需求巨大，需要一种有效压缩方法来降低存储开销。
AI.method: 在均匀Yee网格上，将六个电磁场分量、材料相关更新系数、等效电流源和交错差分算子均表示为兼容的QTT形式；并对体素化材料界面进行高斯正则化以降低介电常数和电导率突变产生的系数秩。
AI.result: 在含多达512³空间单元的网格上评估人头模型和介质球：界面平滑显著降低材料系数秩；TT-FDTD解能重现全网格瞬态场，所选切片上逐点绝对误差约10⁻⁴；相比传统FDTD在细网格下大幅减少存储，但张量收缩与重压缩增加每步计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了QTT加速三维FDTD用于大规模结构化网格仿真的可行性及其内存-时间权衡特性。

title: Linear and nonlinear transport responses of topological nodal-line semimetals
summary: Topological nodal-line semimetals are three-dimensional quantum materials characterized by band crossings that form closed loops in momentum space. In $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric realizations, these nodal rings are stabilized in the absence of spin-orbit coupling, giving rise to drumhead surface states and unconventional transport responses. In this work, we study charge transport across a nodal-line semimetal containing a finite electrostatic barrier, with both leads described by the same equilibrium material. By solving the corresponding scattering problem, we show that the transmission across the barrier exhibits {Klein-tunneling behavior protected at normal incidence by the nodal topology}, despite the extended nodal-line dispersion, which can be traced back to Berry-curvature-induced momentum locking. Using the Landauer-Büttiker formalism, we derive general expressions for the linear and nonlinear conductances, including both longitudinal and Hall components, and evaluate them at zero and finite temperature. Our analytical and numerical results elucidate the dependence of the conductance on barrier height and width, as well as on a $\mathcal{PT}$-breaking mass term. We identify distinct transport regimes in which nonlinear contributions are strongly enhanced and transverse Hall currents emerge, providing clear transport signatures of nodal-line topology and suggesting potential routes toward device applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限静电势垒下节线半金属的电荷输运，发现由节线拓扑保护的Klein隧穿行为，并导出线性与非线性（纵向及Hall）电导。
AI.motivation: 节线半金属在PT对称下具稳定节环、鼓面表面态和非常规输运，但其在势垒下的隧穿与非线性/Hall输运尚待阐明。
AI.method: 求解含静电势垒的散射问题，两侧为同种平衡材料；用Landauer-Büttiker形式导出纵向与Hall的线性及非线性电导，并在零温与有限温度下做解析与数值计算。
AI.result: 透射在正入射时表现出受节线拓扑保护的Klein隧穿（源于Berry曲率诱导的动量锁定）；电导依赖势垒高度、宽度及PT破缺质量项，并存在非线性贡献显著增强、横向Hall电流出现的输运区间。
AI.conclusion: 结果为节线拓扑提供清晰输运特征，并指向潜在器件应用。

title: Anisotropic interface-confined superconductivity in FeTe-based heterostructures
summary: Interface-confined superconductivity emerges from the interaction of electronic states across chemically distinct boundaries, providing a route to engineer superconducting phases where magnetism and topology coexist. Determining the intrinsic nature of such superconductivity, however, is challenging because the superconducting layer is only a few nanometers thick and buried beneath several normal layers. Here, we measure the whole-sample Meissner response of six $\mathrm{FeTe}$-based heterostructures in a uniform magnetic field using a frequency-domain tunnel-diode resonator. In the ultrathin limit, the conventional normalization of the measured susceptibility, $χ(T\to0)=-1$, fails by tens of percent. We establish the appropriate calibration and invert $χ(T)$ to determine the London penetration depth $λ(T)$. Two key results emerge. First, the broad transitions observed in $χ(T)$ arise naturally from the extreme geometry and large $λ$, without requiring chemical or structural inhomogeneity; the extracted $λ(T)$ closely tracks the resistive transition. Second, $λ(T)$ and the corresponding superfluid density are inconsistent with a fully gapped isotropic $s$-wave state and instead indicate a strongly anisotropic order parameter possibly with line nodes or deep gap minima. The inferred $λ(0)$ is of order $1\,μ$m, consistent with an independent analysis of the 2D phase stiffness. Despite the distinct chemical, magnetic, and topological character of the three overlayers, all six FeTe heterostructures exhibit similar low-temperature power-law behavior, with no systematic dependence of the superconducting response on overlayer identity. These results point to the interfacial $\mathrm{FeTe}$ layer as the common origin of superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 测量六种FeTe异质结的Meissner响应，建立校准方法反演穿透深度λ(T)，发现超导来自界面FeTe层，具有强各向异性（可能线节点）配对，与覆盖层无关。
AI.motivation: 界面限制超导可工程化实现磁性与拓扑共存的超导相，但超导层仅几纳米且埋于正常层下，难以确定其本征性质。
AI.method: 用频域隧道二极管谐振器在均匀磁场下测量六种FeTe基异质结的整样品Meissner响应，建立校准并反演χ(T)得到London穿透深度λ(T)。
AI.result: 超薄极限下常规归一化χ(T→0)=-1失效达数十个百分点；宽转变源于几何与大的λ而非不均匀性；λ(T)和超流密度不符合全gapped各向同性s波，指示强各向异性可能含线节点或深gap极小；λ(0)约1μm；六种异质结低温幂律行为相似，与覆盖层无关。
AI.conclusion: 超导共同起源于界面FeTe层，其配对具有强各向异性，与上方覆盖层的化学、磁性和拓扑特征无关。

title: Electronic excitation spectra and recovery of excited states with neural network wave functions
summary: Accurate electronic spectra require both a flexible description of electron correlation and a tractable treatment of the many states contributing to the response. We combine neural network wave functions with the Lorentz integral transform to calculate electronic spectra directly in continuous coordinates, without truncation error from a fixed one-electron basis and with polynomial computational cost per optimization step. Instead of constructing a prescribed set of excited states, the method solves an inhomogeneous Schrödinger equation at a chosen complex energy. This formulation gives access, in principle, to the entire spectrum coupled to a perturbation, including bound excitations and the ionization continuum, without explicitly determining all lower-lying eigenstates. A finite imaginary energy controls the resolution and keeps the response square integrable. Near an isolated bound excitation, the normalized response also recovers the corresponding eigenstate as the width tends to zero. A helium application illustrates the extraction of an excitation energy and oscillator strength. The formulation provides a route from neural descriptions of electronic correlation to spectra beyond a small manifold of low-lying states.

AI.tldr: 将神经网络波函数与Lorentz积分变换结合，直接在连续坐标下计算电子光谱，无需固定单电子基组截断，每步优化计算量多项式增长，可覆盖束缚激发与电离连续谱。
AI.motivation: 精确电子光谱既需要灵活的电子关联描述，又需要可处理众多响应态的可行方法。传统方法受限于固定单电子基组的截断误差，且通常只能处理少量低能激发态。
AI.method: 用神经网络波函数表示电子关联，结合Lorentz积分变换。不显式构造激发态组，而是在选定复能量处求解非齐次Schrödinger方程；有限虚能量部分控制分辨率并保持响应平方可积。宽度趋于零时归一化响应可恢复对应本征态。
AI.result: 该方法原则上可获取与微扰耦合的整个光谱（含束缚激发和电离连续谱），无需确定所有低能本征态。在氦原子上演示了激发能和振子强度的提取。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为从神经电子关联描述走向超越少量低能态的完整光谱计算提供了途径。

title: Derivation of Fokker-Planck equation and its entropy production
summary: We derive the Fokker-Planck equation and its entropy production from the master equation. To this end we consider a discrete space of states where the master equation is defined and appropriate transition rates are introduced. A transition rate has two parts, one of which is the ordinary term proportional to the inverse of the spacing and the other is inversely proportional to the square of the spacing corresponding to the variance of the independent stochastic variable. In the continuous space limit, we obtain the Fokker-Planck as well as the rate of entropy production and the flux of entropy. We also consider the case where the space of states is the phase space and discuss the equations appropriate for systems in contact with several heat reservoirs and for isolated systems.

AI.tldr: 本文从主方程出发，通过引入含间距一次项与间距平方项的跃迁率，在连续空间极限下推导Fokker-Planck方程及其熵产生。
AI.motivation: 从离散主方程导出连续的Fokker-Planck方程及熵产生，为理解随机动力学中的熵流与熵产生提供统一框架，并推广到与多个热库接触及孤立系统的情形。
AI.method: 在离散状态空间上定义主方程，引入两部分跃迁率：一部分正比于间距的倒数，另一部分反比于间距的平方（对应独立随机变量的方差）。取连续空间极限进行推导。
AI.result: 在连续空间极限下得到Fokker-Planck方程、熵产生率以及熵流；并将状态空间取为相空间，给出适用于多热库接触系统和孤立系统的方程。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了离散主方程与连续Fokker-Planck方程、熵产生之间的桥梁，可推广至相空间及多热库/孤立系统情境。

title: Far-field terahertz spectroscopy across the charge-density-wave transition in 2H-NbSe$_2$
summary: Charge-density-wave (CDW) formation in 2H-NbSe$_2$ modifies the low-energy electronic structure and gives rise to collective excitations coupled to the lattice. Here, we investigate bulk 2H-NbSe$_2$ single crystals using far-field terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) in reflection geometry across the CDW transition at $T_{\mathrm{CDW}} \approx 33$~K. Below $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$, the THz response shows a pronounced high-frequency feature near 1.5~THz together with longer-lived sub-THz oscillations. Both responses progressively weaken upon warming and are strongly suppressed across the CDW transition, supporting their association with the CDW state. Using time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau simulations, we reproduce the main features of the experimental THz response, associating the high-frequency response mainly with CDW amplitude dynamics and the sub-THz response with defect-pinned phase dynamics. The $\sim1.5$~THz feature lies close to the frequency range reported for the Raman CDW amplitude mode, while coupling to lattice degrees of freedom may also influence its spectral position. We also performed complementary angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy measurements, which reveal momentum-selective redistribution of near-Fermi-level spectral weight across the transition. Together, these results show that far-field THz spectroscopy provides a sensitive probe of collective CDW dynamics in bulk 2H-NbSe$_2$.

AI.tldr: 利用远场THz-TDS反射光谱研究2H-NbSe₂的CDW集体激发，观测到~1.5 THz的振幅模特征与亚THz的缺陷钉扎相位模，并经时间依赖Ginzburg-Landau模拟和ARPES验证。
AI.motivation: CDW相变会改变2H-NbSe₂的低能电子结构并产生与晶格耦合的集体激发，需要灵敏的探测手段来研究其集体动力学。
AI.method: 对块体2H-NbSe₂单晶在CDW转变温度（~33 K）附近进行远场THz时域光谱（反射几何）测量，并用时间依赖Ginzburg-Landau模拟再现响应；辅以角分辨光电子谱（ARPES）测量。
AI.result: CDW转变以下出现~1.5 THz高频特征及长寿命亚THz振荡，升温后逐渐减弱并在相变处强烈抑制；模拟表明高频响应主要来自CDW振幅动力学，亚THz响应源于缺陷钉扎的相位动力学；ARPES显示近费米能级谱重的动量选择性重分布。
AI.conclusion: 远场THz光谱是探测块体2H-NbSe₂中CDW集体动力学的灵敏手段。

title: Magnetic excitations of the strongly-anisotropic triangular XXZ model: a projected spin-product state approach
summary: Recent experiments have sparked interest on the ground-state properties and on the excitation spectrum of the spin-$1/2$ triangular XXZ model with strong Ising-like anisotropy. In this work, we introduce and analyze a ``projected'' coherent-state approximation to the model, constructed by projecting spin-product states onto the low-energy configurations of the triangular Ising antiferromagnet. Within this approximation, we discuss the structure of the ground-state ordering and the magnetization curve under a longitudinal field. We then discuss the excitation spectrum by linearizing equations of motion deriving from a time-dependent variational principle. This leads to a natural description of spin-wave-like excitations within the strongly constrained Hilbert space. At zero field, the variational approximation leads to a very flat landscape of quasi-degenerate states, which results in a low-energy pseudo-Goldstone mode in the excitation spectrum. We compare our results to experimental measurements on the cobaltite K$_{2}$Co(SeO$_{3}$)$_{2}$ (KCSO). Our approximation leads to a dramatic improvement as compared to linear spin-wave theory. However, there remain deviations in the value of the pseudo-Goldstone gap and in the dispersion near $M$ points at low field.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种“投影”相干态近似方法，用于研究强Ising型各向异性的自旋-1/2三角XXZ模型，并与钴氧化物KCSO实验进行比较。
AI.motivation: 近期实验激发了对强Ising型各向异性自旋-1/2三角XXZ模型基态性质和激发谱的研究兴趣，需要更准确的理论方法来解释实验观测。
AI.method: 构建投影相干态近似：将自旋乘积态投影到三角Ising反铁磁体的低能构型上；分析基态有序结构和纵向场下的磁化曲线；通过含时变分原理线性化运动方程讨论激发谱。
AI.result: 在约束Hilbert空间内得到类自旋波激发的自然描述；零场下变分近似给出准简并态的平坦能量景观，激发谱中出现低能赝Goldstone模；与KCSO实验对比，相比线性自旋波理论有显著改进，但在赝Goldstone能隙值和低场下M点附近色散上仍有偏差。
AI.conclusion: 投影相干态近似能显著改进对KCSO等材料的描述，但赝Goldstone能隙和低场M点色散方面仍存在待解决的偏差。

title: Label-Permutation Symmetry and Stability in Oscillator Potts Machines
summary: Oscillator Potts machines (OPMs) provide a physics-inspired, energy-minimization framework for solving combinatorial optimization problems described by the $q$-state Potts Hamiltonian. Although OPMs may be viewed as multistate extensions of oscillator Ising machines (OIMs), here, we show that they exhibit dynamical properties absent in the binary case. Specifically, we derive a configuration-dependent local-stability condition for a recently proposed multiharmonic OPM formulation and show that configurations with the same Potts energy need not be dynamically equivalent. In particular, for $q\geq4$, permutations of the Potts labels can alter the Jacobian spectrum and, consequently, the regularization strength required to locally stabilize a given Potts configuration. Thus, different phase encodings of the same Potts solution can exhibit different local stability properties despite having identical Potts energies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究振荡器Potts机(OPM)，推导出配置依赖的局部稳定性条件，证明同一Potts能量的配置在动力学上可能不等价，标签置换会改变Jacobian谱及所需正则化强度。
AI.motivation: OPM是受物理启发的能量最小化框架，用于求解q态Potts哈密顿量描述的组合优化问题。作者想探究OPM作为OIM多态扩展时，是否具有二态情形所没有的动力学特性。
AI.method: 针对近期提出的多谐波OPM公式，推导配置依赖的局部稳定性条件，并分析Potts标签置换对Jacobian谱的影响。
AI.result: 发现当q≥4时，Potts标签的置换会改变Jacobian谱，进而改变局部稳定某一Potts配置所需的正则化强度。相同Potts解的不用相位编码可表现出不同的局部稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 具有相同Potts能量的配置在动力学上未必等价，OPM展现出二态Ising机所不具备的动力学特性。

title: Interlayer coupling between twisted graphenes through atomically-precise barriers
summary: Understanding and controlling interlayer coupling in van der Waals (vdW) materials is crucial for engineering novel electronic phenomena, including correlated states, topological phases, and superconductivity. Twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) offers a highly tunable platform to explore how interlayer orientation and separation influence quantum transport and moiré physics. Here, we introduce a method for achieving precise, atomic-scale control of interlayer coupling in TBG using dual-gated devices separated by ultrathin, thickness-tunable hBN spacers. This approach enables systematic control of interlayer interactions, demonstrating that the critical displacement field required for electron-hole bilayer behavior decreases as the layer separation increases at a fixed twist angle. Remarkably, at small twist angles, moiré-related side peaks persist even when layers are separated by tetralayers of hBN (approximately 1.3 nm), indicating robust interlayer band hybridization. By combining atomic-layer-precise control of interlayer coupling with independent twist angle tunability, our platform opens new avenues for discovering novel moiré physics governed by engineered interlayer coupling and moiré patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用双栅器件与厚度可调的hBN间隔层，实现扭转双层石墨烯层间耦合的原子级精确控制，并发现小扭转角下层间带杂化可在约1.3 nm间距下依然保持。
AI.motivation: 层间耦合是决定范德华材料中关联态、拓扑相与超导等新奇电子现象的关键，但如何在原子尺度上精确、可控地调节层间耦合仍具挑战，尤其需要独立于扭转角的调控手段。
AI.method: 采用双栅器件结构，通过超薄、厚度可调的hBN间隔层分隔扭转双层石墨烯，从而在固定扭转角下系统调节层间距与层间相互作用。
AI.result: 固定扭转角时，实现电子-空穴双层行为所需的临界位移场随层间距增大而减小；在小扭转角下，即使层间距达到四层hBN（约1.3 nm），与莫尔相关的侧峰仍存在，表明层间带杂化依然稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该平台将原子层精度的层间耦合调控与独立可调的扭转角相结合，为探索由工程化层间耦合与莫尔图案共同主导的新奇莫尔物理提供了新途径。

title: Imaging phase winding in topological superconductors with a fork-tip Josephson STM
summary: The complex phase winding in a topological superconductor remains challenging to access by conventional real-space probes. We propose a scheme to probe this winding with a fork-tip Josephson STM near an impurity, where two superconducting tips form an interferometer sensitive to phase differences between two positions. The signal remains accessible even if the relative phase between the fork-tip and sample fluctuates, establishing a route towards a local phase-sensitive STM probe of topological superconductivity. We numerically compute the interference pattern to demonstrate that the magnitude and phase of the order parameter can be reconstructed as a function of angle, providing a route towards resolving the longstanding open experimental problem of directly detecting phase winding in topological superconductors.

AI.tldr: 提出用叉形针尖约瑟夫森STM在杂质附近探测拓扑超导体的相位缠绕，数值验证了序参量幅值与相位的角度重构。
AI.motivation: 拓扑超导体中的复杂相位缠绕难以被常规实空间探针获取，直接探测相位缠绕仍是长期未解决的实验难题。
AI.method: 设计叉形针尖约瑟夫森STM方案：两个超导针尖构成干涉仪，对两个位置的相位差敏感；在杂质附近数值计算干涉图案。
AI.result: 即使叉形针尖与样品间的相对相位涨落，信号仍可获取；干涉图案可重构序参量的幅值与相位随角度的变化。
AI.conclusion: 为实现局域相位敏感的STM探针提供了途径，有望解决直接探测拓扑超导体相位缠绕的实验难题。

title: A systematic comparison of hard- and soft-constrained physics-informed molecular machine learning with the Clapeyron equation
summary: In molecular machine learning (ML), significant progress has been made on integrating fundamental thermodynamic relations into ML models. Such physics-informed approaches can be categorized as hard-constrained, where the thermodynamic relations are embedded in the model architecture, and soft-constrained, where relations are included in the training loss. While both approaches have been applied to various property prediction tasks, a systematic comparison on experimental data is lacking. We herein compare hard- and soft-constrained approaches on a numerically challenging case study: the prediction of vapor pressure, saturated liquid and vapor molar volumes, and enthalpy of vaporization as functions of temperature for single-species vapor-liquid equilibrium, related by the exact Clapeyron equation. Furthermore, soft-constrained approaches in molecular ML typically balance data and physics losses with a fixed weighting factor, requiring careful tuning. To overcome this, we investigate the augmented Lagrangian method (ALM), well established in constrained optimization. We find that for the soft-constrained approach, using the ALM improves prediction performance in terms of constraint satisfaction by factor 2 and reduces training epochs compared to using a fixed penalty by 30%. Hence, in the soft-constrained approach, the use of the ALM is always recommended. The hard-constrained approach, which entails additional architectural design choices, can reach on par accuracy with the soft-constrained approach, at even higher thermodynamic consistency, reaching 12 orders of magnitude closer approximation of the Clapeyron equation. Overall, the hard-constrained approach is most promising when thermodynamic consistency is critical, yet requires tailoring the ML model architecture to the respective thermodynamic relation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了分子机器学习中硬约束与软约束两种物理信息方法，在气液平衡性质预测任务上评估，并引入增广拉格朗日法改进软约束，发现硬约束的一致性最佳。
AI.motivation: 分子ML中整合热力学关系的方法分为硬约束（嵌入架构）和软约束（加入损失），但缺乏基于实验数据的系统性对比。此外软约束通常需人工调节数据损失与物理损失的固定权重。
AI.method: 以单组分气液平衡为案例，预测蒸气压、饱和液/气摩尔体积和汽化焓随温度的变化，这些量由精确的Clapeyron方程关联。对比硬约束与软约束方法，并在软约束中采用增广拉格朗日法（ALM）替代固定惩罚权重。
AI.result: 软约束下使用ALM使约束满足性提升2倍，训练轮数减少30%。硬约束需额外架构设计，能达到与软约束相当的精度，但热力学一致性更高，Clapeyron方程近似精度高出约12个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 软约束中始终推荐使用ALM；当热力学一致性至关重要时硬约束最具前景，但需针对具体热力学关系定制模型架构。

title: Localization Transition in Kinetically Deformed one-dimensional Aubry-André Model
summary: We propose a $q$-deformation in the single-particle kinetic energy and investigate how it modifies the localization in the one-dimensional Aubry-André (AA) model. We construct a Hermitian $q$-deformed kinetic operator as a nonlinear function of the lattice translation operator, preserving the uniform lattice and recovering the conventional AA Hamiltonian continuously in the undeformed limit $q\to1$. The deformation generates an infinite set of correlated odd-range kinetic processes, controlled by a single parameter q, rather than phenomenologically involving long-range hopping. Under the dual transformation, this long-range hopping appears as higher harmonics of the dual quasiperiodic potential, providing a controlled route for breaking the exact self-duality of the AA model, with $q$ as the control parameter, consequently modifying the localization structure for $q\neq1$. In contrast to the conventional AA model, where all eigenstates localize simultaneously at $λ_c=2$, the deformed model exhibits a fraction of delocalized states even beyond $λ_c =2$. An intermediate regime also emerges in the $q-λ$ plane where localized and extended eigenstates coexist across the spectrum. We also propose a possible experimental realization of the hierarchy produced in the $q$-deformed kinetic setting in a periodically driven AA model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种对单粒子动能的 $q$-形变，在一维 Aubry-André(AA)模型中研究其对局域化的影响，发现该形变通过非线性平移算符产生关联的奇程跃迁，打破AA模型精确自对偶性，从而改变局域结构。
AI.motivation: 传统AA模型在 $\lambda_c=2$ 处所有本征态同时局域化，且具有精确自对偶性。作者希望引入一种受控的形变机制，打破这一自对偶性，从而研究更丰富的局域-扩展转变结构，并避免唯象地引入长程跃迁。
AI.method: 构造厄米的 $q$-形变动能算符，作为晶格平移算符的非线性函数，保持均匀晶格并在 $q\to1$ 极限下连续回到常规AA哈密顿量。该形变由单一参数 $q$ 控制，产生无穷多关联的奇程动能过程。通过对偶变换分析长程跃迁与对偶准周期势的高次谐波关系。
AI.result: 与常规AA模型在 $\lambda_c=2$ 处所有本征态同时局域化不同，形变模型在 $\lambda_c=2$ 之外仍存在一部分退局域态。在 $q$-$\lambda$ 平面出现中间区域，其中局域态与扩展态在整个谱中共存。还提出了在周期驱动AA模型中实现该动能层级的可能实验方案。
AI.conclusion: $q$-形变动能提供了一种以单参数 $q$ 控制、打破AA模型精确自对偶性的受控途径，产生局域与扩展态共存的新奇局域结构，并具有周期驱动AA模型中的实验实现可能。

title: Altermagnetism produces pair emission and absorption from dark excitons and magnons in La$_2$O$_3$Mn$_2$Se$_2$
summary: Altermagnets' (AMs) non-relativistic spin splitting enables novel states, spintronic and magneto-optical devices, though their optical signatures remain elusive. Here, we report exciton-magnon emission and absorption: optical sidebands from a spin-forbidden dark exciton, a direct consequence of altermagnetic symmetry. Combined optical spectroscopy and first-principles calculations reveal that La$_2$O$_3$Mn$_2$Se$_2$ is an altermagnetic insulator, hosting a strongly bound, spin-forbidden dark exciton and a higher-energy bright exciton. Photoluminescence (PL) and absorption reveal mirror-image sidebands, Stokes-shifted in emission and anti-Stokes-shifted in absorption, symmetric about the dark exciton, whose energy shifts and spectral shapes match the magnon energy scale and density of states measured independently by inelastic neutron scattering. The PL intensity tracks the full equal-time spin-spin correlator, combining static and dynamical contributions, and rules out alternative processes. This directly couples PL to magnetism, with potential for magneto-optical devices. These results establish exciton-magnon spectroscopy as a new route for optically identifying and exploiting AMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文报道了交替磁体La₂O₃Mn₂Se₂中的激子-磁振子发射与吸收，建立了通过激子-磁振子光谱光学识别交替磁体的新途径。
AI.motivation: 交替磁体的非相对论性自旋劈裂可催生新物态及自旋电子学、磁光器件，但其光学特征仍不明确，亟需找到可靠的光学识别手段。
AI.method: 结合光学光谱与第一性原理计算，研究La₂O₃Mn₂Se₂的能带与激子性质；通过光致发光和吸收光谱观测边带，并利用非弹性中子散射独立测量磁振子能量尺度与态密度进行对照。
AI.result: La₂O₃Mn₂Se₂被确认为交替磁绝缘体，具有强束缚的自旋禁戒暗激子和更高能的亮激子。发光与吸收呈现关于暗激子对称的镜像边带（发射为斯托克斯位移，吸收为反斯托克斯位移），其能量移动与谱形与中子散射测得的磁振子能量和态密度吻合；发光强度追踪完整的等时自旋-自旋关联函数。
AI.conclusion: 发光与磁性直接耦合，可用于磁光器件；激子-磁振子光谱成为光学识别与利用交替磁体的新方法。

title: Magnetic properties and Fermi-surface topology of kagome magnet HoV$_6$Sn$_6$
summary: We report a study of the magnetic properties and Fermi-surface topology of the kagome magnet HoV$_6$Sn$_6$ using magnetization and tunnel-diode-oscillator (TDO) measurements. The temperature-dependent magnetization exhibits Curie-Weiss behavior at high temperatures and reveals long-range magnetic order below $T_c$ $\approx$ 2.4 K. Below Tc, the field-dependent magnetization reveals pronounced magnetic anisotropy, with saturation moments of $\approx$ 9.5 and 7 $μ_B$ /Ho for fields applied along the out-of-plane and in-plane directions, respectively. To probe the Fermi surface, we perform TDO measurements in magnetic fields up to 41.5 T and at temperatures down to 0.35 K. The TDO signal exhibits well-defined quantum oscillations with multiple frequencies extending up to $\sim$ 9 kT. Angular- and temperature-dependent measurements are used to determine the Fermi-surface geometry and cyclotron effective masses, respectively. To elucidate the electronic structure, we perform first-principles calculations of the electronic bands, density of states (DOS), and Fermi surface. The calculated band structure exhibits flat-band features, van Hove singularities, and Dirac-like crossings near the Fermi level. The DOS near the Fermi level is dominated by the V-d orbitals, indicating that the V kagome layers play a major role in determining the low-energy electronic properties of HoV6Sn6. Our calculations further support a ferromagnetic ground state with the Ho moments oriented along the c axis, consistent with neutron-scattering measurements. The calculated quantum-oscillation frequencies from the Fermi-surface pockets of HoV6Sn6 are in overall good agreement with the experimentally observed frequencies. Our combined experimental and theoretical results provide insight into the magnetic anisotropy and electronic structure of HoV$_6$Sn$_6$ and reveal its multiband Fermi-surface topology.

AI.tldr: 通过磁化与TDO测量结合第一性原理计算，研究了kagome磁体HoV6Sn6的磁性和费米面拓扑，揭示其多带费米面特征与磁各向异性。
AI.motivation: 探究kagome磁体HoV6Sn6的磁性各向异性及电子结构，特别是V kagome层对低能电子性质的贡献及其费米面拓扑。
AI.method: 结合磁化测量与隧道二极管振荡器（TDO）测量（最高41.5 T磁场、最低0.35 K温度），并进行第一性原理计算，分析能带、态密度和费米面。
AI.result: 高温呈Curie-Weiss行为，Tc≈2.4 K以下出现长程磁序；饱和磁矩约9.5（面外）和7 μB/Ho（面内）；观察到多频率量子振荡（高达~9 kT）；计算的振荡频率与实验总体吻合；DOS由V-d轨道主导。
AI.conclusion: HoV6Sn6具有多带费米面拓扑和显著磁各向异性，V kagome层主导低能电子性质，计算支持Ho磁矩沿c轴取向的铁磁基态，与中子散射一致。

title: From Bellissard's gap labeling to atomistic quasiperiodic bilayers
summary: Bellissard's framework uses covariant observables to describe aperiodic solids. We examine how butterfly-like spectra in twisted bilayers can be related to bulk gap labels and topological response. A bulk gap permits a spectral projector and an integrated density of states. A topological response requires an additional pairing of that projector. In an illustrative finite honeycomb bilayer, an exact second-moment identity isolates the interlayer contribution to spectral variance. Angle-resolved spectra, finite state counts, an uncoupled reference, and size and broadening checks show how coupling redistributes spectral weight without assigning a bulk gap label. We then examine the requirements for atomistic electronic-structure calculations, including nonorthogonal orbitals, projected densities of states, and basis functions that move during relative sliding. The resulting framework specifies the steps needed to connect atomistic spectra with bulk state counting and topological response.

AI.tldr: 本文在Bellissard协变可观测框架下，探讨扭转双层中蝴蝶状谱与体隙标签、拓扑响应的关联，并通过有限蜂窝双层模型提出层间贡献的精确二阶矩恒等式。
AI.motivation: Bellissard框架用协变可观测描述非周期固体。作者希望厘清扭转双层中的蝴蝶状谱如何与体隙标签及拓扑响应建立联系，并明确将原子尺度电子结构计算与该框架衔接所需的条件。
AI.method: 通过体隙定义谱投影算符和积分态密度，并对投影算符引入额外配对以刻画拓扑响应；在一个有限蜂窝双层模型中推导精确的第二阶矩恒等式以分离层间对谱方差的贡献；结合角度分辨谱、有限态计数、未耦合参照以及尺寸与展宽检验进行分析；进一步讨论非正交轨道、投影态密度和相对滑动中移动的基函数等原子尺度计算要求。
AI.result: 精确的二阶矩恒等式分离出层间耦合对谱方差的贡献；角度分辨谱、有限态计数及尺寸/展宽检验表明，耦合会重新分配谱权重，但并未赋予体隙标签。
AI.conclusion: 该框架明确了将原子尺度谱与体态计数及拓扑响应相联结所需的步骤，并指出仅凭谱权重再分配不足以确定体隙标签。

title: Ohm's law for information revealed by a skyrmion Maxwell's demon
summary: Reducing the energy cost of computation-a pressing issue in the age of AI-requires a framework for circuit design based on information thermodynamics. By extending non-equilibrium statistical mechanics to information thermodynamics, it has been shown that a probability flow carrying information-hereinafter referred to as an 'information current'-is driven by its conjugate thermodynamic force, namely 'information affinity'. Since information affinity plays a role analogous to that of voltage in an electrical circuit, it is suggested that information transport also follows a linear response relationship analogous to Ohm's law. However, despite this theoretical prediction, experimentally establishing an Ohm-like constitutive relation for information transport remains an important unsolved problem. Here, we realise an information engine consisting of two magnetic skyrmions undergoing Brownian motion at room temperature. We demonstrate that the resulting information current is proportional to the information affinity generated by Maxwell's demon over a relatively wide range, establishing Ohm's law for information. Furthermore, we clarify that, in real information circuits, both Ohm's law for information and Kirchhoff's voltage law must be slightly modified to account for interactions between information carriers and the scattering of the information current.

AI.tldr: 本文在室温下用两个磁性斯格明子的布朗运动实现"信息引擎"，实验证明信息流与麦克斯韦妖产生的信息亲和力成正比，确立了信息版欧姆定律，并指出实际信息电路中需对欧姆定律和基尔霍夫电压定律稍作修正。
AI.motivation: 降低计算能耗是AI时代的紧迫问题，需要基于信息热力学的电路设计框架。理论预测信息传输应遵循类似欧姆定律的线性响应关系，但实验上一直未能确立该本构关系，这是重要的未解问题。
AI.method: 构建由两个在室温下做布朗运动的磁性斯格明子组成的信息引擎，测量由麦克斯韦妖产生的信息亲和力所驱动的信息流，并考察信息载流子间相互作用与信息流散射的影响。
AI.result: 在较宽的范围内，信息流与信息亲和力成正比，证实了信息版欧姆定律；同时发现实际信息电路中欧姆定律与基尔霍夫电压定律都需略作修正，以计入载流子相互作用和信息流散射。
AI.conclusion: 实验首次确立了信息传输的类欧姆本构关系，为基于信息热力学的电路设计奠定实验基础，并揭示实际信息电路需修正经典电路定律。

title: Tuning the secondary electron yield and electronic conductivity of MgZnO multilayers synthesized by Atomic layer deposition
summary: Secondary electron emission (SEE), arising from the interaction of energetic electrons with material surfaces, can induce deleterious effects in vacuum radio-frequency (RF) systems, notably multipacting, thereby degrading performance and threatening device integrity. Despite extensive efforts, effective and widely adopted mitigation strategies remain limited. Here, we report an approach to simultaneously tailor SEE and electrical conductivity using nanometric multi-element multilayers deposited by atomic layer deposition (ALD). The design and fabrication of these heterostructures are presented, and a range of films is systematically characterized to establish correlations between emission properties, electrical conductivity, chemical and structural features. We demonstrate that such heterostructures enable combinations of total electron emission yield (TEEY) and conductivity unattainable in single-phase materials, including regimes combining high TEEY with relatively high conductivity and low TEEY with low conductivities. These results open new avenues for the rational design of functional surfaces for vacuum electronic applications.

AI.tldr: 利用原子层沉积(ALD)制备纳米多层异质结构，同时调控二次电子发射(SEE)与电导率，实现单相材料无法达到的TEEY-电导率组合。
AI.motivation: 二次电子发射(SEE)会在真空射频系统中引发多磁共振等有害效应，降低性能并威胁器件完整性，但目前有效且广泛采用的抑制策略仍然有限。
AI.method: 采用原子层沉积(ALD)制备纳米级多元素多层异质结构，对一系列薄膜进行系统表征，建立发射特性、电导率与化学结构特征之间的关联。
AI.result: 该类异质结构实现了单相材料无法达到的总电子发射产额(TEEY)与电导率组合，包括高TEEY配较高电导率、以及低TEEY配低电导率的区间。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为真空电子应用中功能性表面的理性设计开辟了新途径。

title: Adaptive Expansions of the Optimized Effective Potential in Physically Motivated Response Spaces
summary: The optimized effective potential (OEP) method provides an exact framework for incorporating orbital-dependent exchange within Kohn-Sham (KS) density-functional theory (DFT). Its practical implementation requires representing the exchange-response potential in a suitable auxiliary space, yet conventional choices are not necessarily adapted to the physical structure of the OEP response. Here, we introduce a general response-space strategy in which physically motivated response functions from existing model exchange potentials are repurposed as adaptive auxiliary directions for the OEP equation. Specifically, response functions associated with the Becke-Johnson (BJ), R"as"anen-Pittalis-Proetto (RPP), Gritsenko-van Leeuwen-van Lenthe-Baerends (GLLB), Krieger-Li-Iafrate (KLI), and localized Hartree-Fock (LHF) constructions are incorporated into compact auxiliary spaces, while their coefficients are determined directly from the projected OEP equation rather than fixed by the underlying model potentials. This establishes a systematic connection between model exchange potentials and finite-basis OEP: model potentials provide physically informed response directions, while OEP determines their system-dependent amplitudes. The framework encompasses one- and multidimensional response spaces, including occupied-orbital and occupied-pair representations, without modifying the underlying OEP condition. We show that these physically adapted spaces capture the dominant spatial structures of the OEP exchange response with substantially fewer degrees of freedom than conventional auxiliary expansions. The proposed approach therefore provides a general route to compact, adaptive representations of exchange-only OEP potentials and a systematic framework for developing low-dimensional OEP approximations from physically motivated model response functions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种通用响应空间策略，将已有模型交换势（BJ、RPP、GLLB、KLI、LHF）的响应函数作为OEP方程的适应性辅助方向，用以构建紧凑的OEP交换势表示。
AI.motivation: OEP方法虽为DFT中轨道依赖交换的精确框架，但其实际实现需在辅助空间表示交换响应势，而传统辅助基组选择并不契合OEP响应的物理结构，导致所需自由度过多。
AI.method: 将BJ、RPP、GLLB、KLI、LHF等模型交换势的物理响应函数重新用作OEP方程的适应性辅助方向；其系数不由模型势固定，而是直接从投影后的OEP方程中确定；框架涵盖一维与多维响应空间，包括占据轨道和占据轨道对表示，且不修改原始OEP条件。
AI.result: 这些物理适配空间能以远少于传统辅助展开的自由度，捕捉OEP交换响应的主导空间结构；同时建立了模型交换势与有限基OEP之间的系统联系——模型势提供物理响应方向，OEP决定其系统依赖的幅度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为交换-only OEP势的紧凑自适应表示提供了通用途径，并为基于物理模型响应函数发展低维OEP近似提供了系统框架。

title: Derivation of the General Solution of the Black-Scholes Boundary-Value Problem
summary: There are infinitely many functions that satisfy the Black-Scholes partial differential equation and the terminal condition corresponding to the European call option. This means that the Black-Scholes formula, which led to the award of the 1997 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences, is not the unique solution, as was once assumed. Consequently, it violates the law of one price, one of the fundamental laws of economics and finance. In this article, we present a rigorous derivation of these solutions to the Black-Scholes boundary value problem.

AI.tldr: 本文证明满足Black-Scholes偏微分方程及欧式看涨期权终端条件的解不唯一，存在无穷多解，因此Black-Scholes公式并非唯一解，违反一价定律。作者给出该边值问题解集的严格推导。
AI.motivation: Black-Scholes公式曾被视为该边值问题的唯一解，并因此获1997年诺贝尔经济学奖。但若解不唯一，则公式违反一价定律这一经济学金融学基本定律，需重新审视其理论基础。
AI.method: 对Black-Scholes边值问题进行严格的数学推导，构造并刻画满足该偏微分方程及欧式看涨期权终端条件的全部解。
AI.result: 满足方程与终端条件的解有无穷多个，说明Black-Scholes公式不具唯一性，从而破坏一价定律。
AI.conclusion: Black-Scholes公式并非该边值问题的唯一解，其作为定价基准的合理性受到挑战；作者通过严格推导给出完整的解族。

title: Facet- and thickness-dependent band-edge alignment at ZrSe\texorpdfstring{$_3$}{3} surfaces: hybrid-functional calculations with spin-orbit coupling
summary: Transition-metal trichalcogenides MX$_3$ are quasi-one-dimensional van der Waals materials whose layers form through lateral chain binding, giving them an interlayer cleavage plane and in-plane electronic anisotropy. Among them, ZrSe$_3$ is stable under ambient conditions and semiconducting. Exfoliated crystals expose four crystallographic planes, and electrocatalytic measurements on an individual crystal assigned the hydrogen evolution activity to the high-energy (210) facet rather than to the basal plane. Those non-basal surfaces remain uncharacterized, since the available calculations treat either the bulk crystal or the free-standing basal monolayer. Here, we compute the surface energies and the equilibrium morphology of these four surfaces with a dispersion-corrected semilocal functional, and their band-edge alignment with the HSE06 hybrid functional including spin-orbit coupling. The surface energies span nearly an order of magnitude, from \SI{0.097}{\joule\per\meter\squared} for (001) to \SI{0.869}{\joule\per\meter\squared} for (010), and the Wulff shape exposes the four observed planes with area fractions of \SI{17.1}{\percent}, \SI{4.4}{\percent}, \SI{71.4}{\percent}, and \SI{7.0}{\percent}. The ionization potential varies by \SI{0.45}{\electronvolt} between facets and the electron affinity by \SI{0.80}{\electronvolt}, the gap of (210) falls from 1.43 to \SI{0.94}{\electronvolt} between 10 and \SI{23}{\angstrom}, and (010) remains metallic. The facets separate according to whether the cut preserves or distorts the Se-Se dimer, and the distorted dimers concentrate the frontier states. Because the same dimer governs the bulk electronic structure of the MX$_3$ family, the criterion transfers to the related trichalcogenides.

AI.tldr: 本文用色散校正半局域泛函与HSE06(含自旋轨道耦合)计算ZrSe₃四种晶面的表面能、平衡形貌和能带对齐，揭示晶面活性差异源于Se-Se二聚体的保持或畸变。
AI.motivation: ZrSe₃为非基面晶面(如高活性(210))的实验表征缺乏理论支持，已有计算仅针对体相或自由基底面单层，无法解释非基面性质。
AI.method: 用色散校正半局域泛函计算四种晶面((001)、(010)、(210)等)的表面能与Wulff平衡形貌；用含自旋轨道耦合的HSE06杂化泛函计算能带边缘对齐。
AI.result: 表面能从(001)的0.097 J/m²到(010)的0.869 J/m²，跨近一个数量级；Wulff形貌暴露四种观测晶面，面积分数为17.1%、4.4%、71.4%、7.0%。电离势晶面间差0.45 eV，电子亲和能差0.80 eV；(210)带隙从1.43 eV(10 Å)降至0.94 eV(23 Å)，(010)保持金属性。晶面按Se-Se二聚体是否保持或畸变分类，畸变二聚体集中前沿态。
AI.conclusion: 晶面电子性质由Se-Se二聚体保持/畸变决定，该判据适用于整个MX₃家族的三硫属化合物。

title: Quantum metric induced nonlinear transport in the hidden loop-current phase of kagome metal RbV$_3$Sb$_5$
